Subject: Proposal: Dedicated H200 bridge for EmeraldAI

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the deep dive today — appreciated the clarity on your short-term ML runway. Per our discussion, attaching an updated dedicated capacity quote that reflects a transient bridge using H200-class nodes (rather than our default H100 offering). Key points in the attached quote: 

- Term: 3-month transient bridge while your procurement of in-region H100 capacity completes.
- Capacity: 12 reserved GPUs (H200) with burst allowance of up to 30% for scheduled model warm-up windows.
- Pricing: temporary rate is ~12% above standard H100 commit rate to reflect H200 unit economics; overage rate cap requested in this thread.
- Reservation hold: we can place a 10-business-day reservation hold on the proposed capacity while your PO/contract executes.

Action items for EmeraldAI: please confirm the PO timeline and whether the 10-day hold is sufficient. If you need a longer hold we can consider a refundable deposit alternative (Aditya can scope).

I know you asked about a hard overage cap for the first month — I flagged that internally and copied Aditya so we can propose an exception path quickly.

Attachments: EmeraldAI_Dedicated_Quote_v2.pdf, SOW-EmeraldAI-draft.docx

Short version of ask: EmeraldAI wants temporary H200 bridge + a one-month overage cap at X (sought by customer). Can we approve the hold and an upfront capped overage for month 1 pending contract signature?

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa — quick follow-up from our side.

We reviewed the quote with finance. Two requests before we can sign:

1) Overages: can Redwood cap overages at $10k for the first 30 days while our traffic normalizes? That protects our runway while still allowing bursts.
2) Reservation hold: 10 business days is tight. Could you hold capacity for 21 days if we submit a good-faith PO or a 25% refundable deposit?

Also, a quick note on GPU type: H200s are fine for warm-up, but we want assurance on functional parity for quantized transformer workloads (latency targets). If you can confirm any perf guarantees or mitigations (e.g., fallback to H100 if latency > X), that would help procurement signoff.

Team — looping you in. EmeraldAI (high-growth ML infra customer) just asked for two non-standard asks: 21-day reservation hold (or refundable deposit) and an explicit one-month overage cap of $10k. They also want some perf assurance for H200 vs H100.

Why this matters: If we approve the transient H200 bridge and the $10k cap for month 1, we lock a ~$600k ARR contract that expands their footprint in Q4. We will convert them to H100 standard commit in 60–90 days.

Risks and mitigations: 
- Financial risk: a $10k cap creates an upside limit but reduces revenue volatility and accelerates signature. Aditya, we've priced the bridge to account for H200 unit cost; the quoted premium partly mitigates cost delta.
- Capacity risk: holding 12 H200 GPUs for 21 days without a signed PO — recommend refundable deposit option (25% of first month) in lieu of longer free hold. Legal (Marcus) — can you confirm the wording for a deposit clause quickly?
- Perf: Marcus / Infra can we attach an SLA clause: fallback to H100 within 2 hours if observed 95th latency > 350ms for two consecutive hours? If not, propose an alternative mitigation statement.

Attachments: EmeraldAI_Dedicated_Quote_v2.pdf, SOW-EmeraldAI-draft.docx

Requested approvals: 
1) Authorize a 21-day reservation hold conditioned on a 25% refundable deposit OR a 10-business-day free hold (company standard).
2) Approve a one-month overage cap of $10k for EmeraldAI for the initial 30-day stabilization window.
3) Approve H200 temporary bridge with the stated premium and a fallback mitigation to H100 if perf thresholds breach.

If you can sign off in principle, I will send an updated quote and a short deposit addendum to EmeraldAI tonight.

Best,
Vanessa

Vanessa / Aditya / Marcus — reviewed. Approve the exception with the following binding conditions: 

1) Reservation hold: approve a 21-calendar-day hold only if EmeraldAI signs a refundable deposit addendum (25% of month-1 committed cost) within 5 business days of the hold start. If payment is not submitted, downgrade to a 10-business-day free hold and release capacity.

2) Overage cap: approve the one-month overage cap of $10,000 for the initial 30-day stabilization window, subject to the following clawback: if EmeraldAI exceeds a 40% increase in sustained token consumption vs forecast during that month, Redwood reserves the right to invoice the excess at standard overage rates for the amount above the 40% threshold. This protects us from margin erosion.

3) H200 bridge & perf: approve H200 temporary bridge. Marcus — include a short performance mitigation clause in the SOW: Redwood will attempt an automated failover to H100 within 2 hours if 95th percentile latency exceeds 350ms for two consecutive measurement windows; if failover is not available, customer may request a targeted capacity migration and Redwood will provide engineering support priority for the migration.

4) Legal/commercial: Marcus, please draft the deposit addendum and the clawback language and circulate a redline to Vanessa and EmeraldAI by EOD tomorrow. Aditya — prepare the updated quote with the approved $10k cap and the deposit line item. Vanessa — send the updated quote + deposit addendum to Priya/Sanjay once you have the redlined wording.

Conditional exec note: this is a one-off exception but commercially justified given conversion potential. Keep me posted.
